stages.title: Requirements
stages.prompt: Clarify the prompt: primary capabilities, completion conditions, error handling, and scope boundaries. State what's in and out of scope.

tip.label: Scope it tight
tip.description: Bullet list of in-scope behaviors + an 'Out of Scope' line.

stages.title: Entities & Relationships
stages.prompt: Extract the meaningful nouns from requirements. Sketch how they interact and which entity orchestrates the main workflow.

tip.label: Pick the orchestrator
tip.description: Name the entity that drives the main workflow.

stages.title: Class Design
stages.prompt: For each entity, define state (fields) and behavior (methods). Keep rules with the entity that owns the relevant state.

tip.label: State + Behavior per class
tip.description: Fields + methods. Encapsulate rules with the owner.

stages.title: Implementation
stages.prompt: Pseudo-code the major methods. Start with the happy path, then edge cases. Trace through one concrete scenario.

tip.label: Happy path first
tip.description: Pseudo-code the key methods, then handle edge cases.

stages.title: Extensibility
stages.prompt: How would the design evolve to support a follow-up feature? Stay high-level — point to the parts that make the change clean.

tip.label: Point at the seams
tip.description: Stay high-level. Where does the design flex?
